three_judgments.path: FAILS BOTH RAILS (automatic DROP). Mechanism: licensing/OEM flywheel (Eurofase + NVIDIA) layers capital-light royalty rev onto the ~10% hardware base, inflecting growth to ~22-24% and carrying mix to CF-positive, re-rating ~$150M-cap to the $5 sell-side target (~4x). Tested vs §7 discriminators it SHOWS 0/4 and ASSERTS the 2 it leans on: (1) backlog converting ABSENT — no firm backlog; Eurofase has NO disclosed terms (framework=MOU-equivalent); '100k units/homes by end-2026' is aspiration; (2) on-date binary milestone ABSENT — 'CF-positive exiting 2026' is soft, no interim dated catalyst, no stated rev/margin threshold; (3) firm-cash Tier-1 anchor ASSERTED-NOT-SHOWN — NVIDIA 'Connect Program' is an open developer-ecosystem membership ('beginning of our collaboration'); $4B Miami smart-city has 'no binding commercial contract or revenue' = logo/MOU, the structure §7 excludes; (4) margin/CF inflection ABSENT — still -$3.9M adj-EBITDA & -$6.0M OCF/qtr, and OCF burn DETERIORATED YoY (-$4.3M→-$6.0M). Textbook round-tripper: loud flywheel narrative on a framework + a logo, no firm anchor, deteriorating cash. Even the $5 target (~4x) is a 12mo sell-side target on a 10% organic grower with no evidence-backed acceleration — not a credible ≥4x; and with no defined catalyst + no protection (dilutive cash-burner) it is NOT a high-confidence protected 3-4x great trade either. Neither kind → automatic DROP.
three_judgments.asymmetry: WEAK (independent DROP). Bull ~3-4x to a hopeful sell-side target (low prob, needs flywheel to actually monetize + growth to ~double). Base ~flat-to-down: a 10% grower funding a ~$6M/qtr burn via ATM at ~$1.20 — share count +27% YoY caps per-share upside even if revenue grows. Bear ~-50%+: another depressed-price raise, growth stays ~10%, flywheel stays a slide. Rough U/D ≈ 3-4x up at low prob vs -50%+ at meaningful prob, with a structural dilution drag on the numerator — upside does NOT clearly dominate.
three_judgments.survival: Fragile but NOT automatic §9 ruin. Cash $32.3M (incl $2.05M restricted) vs ~$6M/qtr OCF burn (deteriorating) → ~5 qtrs runway against a CF-positive target only 'exiting 2026' with NO stated rev/margin threshold. Debt ~$18M convertible, FIXED conversion $1.07-$3.00 (no classic floating death-spiral; Belami $2.25-floor monthly equity-for-debt is semi-variable but small); no going-concern flag. Permanent-impairment driver = chronic dilution to fund the burn (not a debt wall) — survival realistically requires ANOTHER dilutive raise, which removes any 'protection' the great-trade rail needs and reinforces the asymmetry drag. Not a kill on its own; compounds the J1/J2 DROP.

strongest_bear: A perennially-diluting ~10% organic grower dressed as an AI-licensing platform: every 'catalyst' (Eurofase, NVIDIA Connect, $4B Miami) is a framework, an open ecosystem-program logo, or an MOU with ZERO disclosed cash terms, while the company funds a worsening ~$6M/qtr cash burn by selling stock near its lows (+27% shares in a year). No firm backlog, no dated milestone, no anchor cash contract, no printed margin/CF inflection — the $5 target and 'licensing will be a major thing' are narrative; the cash-flow statement and the share count are the reality. Upside requires the flywheel to suddenly monetize against a dilution headwind that caps per-share returns. Corroborated by all four discriminators; refuted by none.
drop_reason: no-path + weak-proxy/thin-setup — path SHOWS 0/4 §7 discriminators and rests on an Eurofase framework + an NVIDIA Connect-Program logo (no disclosed terms, no firm cash anchor, no converting backlog, no dated milestone) with a DETERIORATING -$6M/qtr OCF burn; neither a credible ≥4x nor a high-confidence protected 3-4x. Compounded by weak (dilution-capped) asymmetry and fragile survival reliant on another raise. Automatic DROP (no credible path of either kind), and not a real-enough shot to earn a scarce Tier-3 slot.
best_vehicle: SKYX itself (standalone Monster-shape; no Tier-0 cohort/benchmark). No better on-list vehicle implicated — this is a single-name DROP, not a proxy-swap; the smart-home/licensing 'theme' is a single-name narrative, not a live HUNT theme.
